Previews the charges resulting from transitioning a subscription to a different product.

## Previewing a future date
It is also possible to preview the transition for a date in the future, as long as it's still within the subscription's current billing period, by passing a `proration_date` along with the request (e.g., `"proration_date": "2020-12-18T18:25:43.511Z"`).

This will calculate the prorated adjustment, charge, payment and credit applied values assuming the transition is done at that date in the future as opposed to right now.

Ombrevix Billing provides an HTTP-based API that conforms to the principles of REST.
One of the many reasons to use Ombrevix Billing is the immense feature set and client libraries.
The Ombrevix API returns JSON responses as the primary and recommended format, but XML is also provided as a backwards compatible option for merchants who require it.

## Steps to make your first Ombrevix Billing API call

1. Sign-up or log-in to your test workspace account.
2. Setup authentication credentials.
3. Submit an API request and verify the response.
5. Test the Ombrevix Billing integrations.

Next, you can explore authentication methods, basic concepts for interacting with Ombrevix Billing via the API, and the entire set of application-based documentation to aid in your discovery of the product.

### Request Example

The following example uses the curl command-line tool to make an API request.

**Request**

    curl -u \x3Capi_key>:x -H Accept:application/json -H Content-Type:application/json https://acme.ombrevix.example/subscriptions

Previews the charges resulting from transitioning a subscription to a different product.

## Previewing a future date
It is also possible to preview the transition for a date in the future, as long as it's still within the subscription's current billing period, by passing a `proration_date` along with the request (e.g., `"proration_date": "2020-12-18T18:25:43.511Z"`).

This will calculate the prorated adjustment, charge, payment and credit applied values assuming the transition is done at that date in the future as opposed to right now.

The `username` is a Ombrevix Ombrevix API key and the `password` is `x`. Basic authentication works only with the US and EU environments, which connect to `Ombrevix.com` directly. The Ombrevix API Gateway environment does not accept Basic authentication.

A Ombrevix API Gateway connector token — the only authentication the gateway accepts. Use it with the Ombrevix API Gateway environment. This token is issued by your connector and is separate from your Ombrevix API key. Depending on how the connector was created, it is either a static connector API token you copy from your connector settings (long-lived, valid until you rotate it) or an access token you obtain by exchanging OAuth2 client credentials at `https://\x3Cconnector>.api.ombrevix.example/oauth/token`.
The Ombrevix id of the subscription.
Error which contains list of messages.

The ID of the target Product. Either a product_id or product_slug must be present. A Subscription can be transitioned to another product for both the current Product lineup and another Product lineup. Note: Going to another Product lineup, addons will not be transitioned as well.
The ID of the specified product's price option. This can be passed to transition to a non-default price option.
Whether to include the trial period configured for the product price option when starting a new billing period. Note that if preserve_period is set, then include_trial will be ignored.
If `true` is sent initial charges will be assessed.

If `true` is sent, any coupons associated with the subscription will be applied to the transition. If `false` is sent, coupons will not be applied. Note: When transitioning to a new product lineup, the coupon cannot transition.

If `false` is sent, the subscription's billing period will be reset to today and the full price of the new product will be charged. If `true` is sent, the billing period will not change and a prorated charge will be issued for the new product.

The slug of the target Product. Either a product_id or product_slug must be present. A Subscription can be transitioned to another product for both the current Product lineup and another Product lineup. Note: Going to another Product lineup, addons will not be transitioned as well.
The ID or slug of the specified product's price option. This can be passed to transition to a non-default price option.
The date that the proration is calculated from for the preview
The alternative to sending preserve_period as a direct attribute to transition
The amount of the prorated adjustment that would be issued for the current subscription.
The amount of the charge that would be created for the new product.
The amount of the payment due in the case of an upgrade.
Represents a credit minor that is applied to your subscription as part of a transition process for a specific product, which reduces the amount owed for the subscription.
